name: apple-business-mcp
description: Every Apple Business API call, plus offline fleet answers: unassigned devices, AppleCare expiry and Activation Lock.

apple_business_client_id.title: APPLE_BUSINESS_CLIENT_ID
apple_business_client_id.description: API account Client ID, e.g. BUSINESSAPI.<uuid>.

apple_business_key_id.title: APPLE_BUSINESS_KEY_ID
apple_business_key_id.description: Key ID shown for the API account's private key (JWT kid header).

apple_business_private_key.title: APPLE_BUSINESS_PRIVATE_KEY
apple_business_private_key.description: ES256 private key for the API account: PEM text or a path to the downloaded .pem file.

apple_business_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
apple_business_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

apple_business_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
apple_business_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

apple_business_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
apple_business_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

apple_business_token_url.title: Token endpoint (optional)
apple_business_token_url.description: Leave blank. Defaults to Apple's token endpoint at https://account.apple.com/auth/oauth2/token.

apple_business_user_agent.title: User-Agent header (optional)
apple_business_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Apple Business requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

apple_business_access_token.title: APPLE_BUSINESS_ACCESS_TOKEN
apple_business_access_token.description: Optional override; leave blank. A bearer token minted elsewhere: while set, it is the run's whole identity. It replaces any configured or saved account, requests send it, its data stays in its own local store, the private key is not read and nothing is minted or saved. It expires in an hour and is not renewed.
